# Copilot instructions

- Before changing any file, inspect the relevant code and prepare the complete proposed diff.
- Show the diff and briefly explain the intended changes; do not edit files, run formatters, or otherwise modify the workspace until the user explicitly approves that diff.
- If the proposed changes need to change after approval, show the revised diff and wait for approval again.
- After approval, apply only the approved changes, then summarize the files changed and the validation performed.
